children: AURA SYSTEMS INC reported a weak first quarter of fiscal 2027, with revenue collapsing to $2K as the company shifted focus to prototype development. The quarter produced a net loss of $8.408M, or ($0.06) per diluted share, compared with a net loss of $2.841M, or ($0.02) per diluted share, in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue: $2K for Q1 FY2027 (three months ended May 31, 2026), down from $185K in the year‑ago quarter (≈(99%) YoY).
Net income: Net loss $8.408M for Q1 FY2027, versus net loss $2.841M in the year‑ago quarter (worsened YoY).
Diluted EPS: Loss per share ($0.06) for Q1 FY2027, versus loss per share ($0.02) in the year‑ago quarter (more negative YoY).
Revenue Trajectory: Sales fell sharply to $2 as the company prioritized prototype development, delaying meaningful commercial revenue.
Channel & GTM Shift: Management is transitioning from legacy product sales toward new product commercialization and is exploring selective licensing and joint-venture opportunities.
Product & Engineering Milestones: Completed designs for multiple new axial flux machines spanning roughly 1.5kW to 250kW and expanded R&D tools and hires.
R&D Investment & Capabilities: Increased engineering headcount with Ph.D./M.S. hires and incurred approximately $1.6M in engineering, software, and prototype expenses during the quarter.
Market Positioning: The company emphasizes axial flux advantages—higher efficiency, smaller size, and no rare-earth magnets—targeting industrial, EV, military, and wind markets.
